# wanted-and-swap

Synthetic, built from recorded PC sales (`only`) with titles and descriptions edited; buyer
adverts are rare (15 of 3,865, `fb-scrap-engine/docs/design/PARTS_INTELLIGENCE.md:219`), so they
are added on purpose. Rows 11 and 12 (`2126837844711748`, `1154042653756525`) are kept as
recorded: priced headset sales, never wanted adverts.

- `1816901372840238` "WANTED: Gaming PC with RTX 3080 or better": `wanted`.
- `1756692548940192` "We buy gaming PCs - cash paid": `buy_in`.
- `1123980543398026` "Gaming PC", description opening "I buy all gaming PCs": `buy_in` (first
  sentence, no part offered in the title).
- `1352645884594841` "Swap my PS5 for a gaming PC": `swap`.
- `1775698700306989` "Gaming PC - no swaps": negated, no reason.
- `28242423458759790` "Gaming PC, swaps considered": a sale that welcomes swaps, no reason.
- `2005582460147017` "Gaming PC for sale or swap": a sale, no reason.
- `1083674317719227` "Gaming PC spares or repairs": a faulty item for sale, not a service.
